name: @fossil-lang/codemirror-fossil
description: The fossil language layer for CodeMirror 6: fossil(program) over @fossil-lang/wasm's openProgram — highlighting from the compiler's own lexer, diagnostics from its checker (→ @codemirror/lint), and hover, completion and go-to-definition from the same fossil-ide answers the language server gives. Extensions only — it composes into any editor rather than being one.
//peers: @codemirror/lint is NOT optional and the others are not either — this package IS the wiring between them and fossil, so a consumer that has none of them has no use for it. @fossil-lang/wasm is a peer rather than a dependency because `fossil(program)` takes the host's FossilProgram, and two copies of its glue is the duplication packages/wasm's leaf-module split exists to prevent.
